category_edits.rationale: Test whether a mild causal prefix-length feature distinguishes short histories from established contexts across all four datasets. Scale only history inputs by 1+0.1*(1-exp(-k/8)), preserving padding zeros, candidate embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the same model implementation and validates feature metadata.

edits.replace:
def _interest_states(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.item_emb(seq)
        prefix_length = seq.ne(0).to(emb.dtype).cumsum(dim=1)
        history_scale = 1.0 + 0.1 * (1.0 - torch.exp(-prefix_length / 8.0))
        emb = self.dropout(emb * history_scale.unsqueeze(-1))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)

change_summary: Add deterministic causal prefix-length scaling to history embeddings, with matching predictor metadata validation. Preserve one model per category, routing, checkpoint shapes and training settings.
